description: Use of the ground floor side and rear extension as a nursery (Use Class E(f)) for up to 18 children between the hours of 07:30 and 18:30 Monday to Friday, with use of the entire property as a single-family dwellinghouse (Use Class C3) at all other times; installation of rooflights and three air conditioning units; and erection of a lightweight canopy with timber screening to enclose the side yard area (retrospective).

<p class="MsoListParagraph" style=""><!--[if !supportLists]--><span lang="EN-US" style="">1.<span style="font-variant-numeric: normal; font-variant-east-asian: normal; font-variant-alternates: normal; font-size-adjust: none; font-language-override: normal; font-kerning: auto; font-optical-sizing: auto; font-feature-settings: normal; font-variation-settings: normal; font-variant-position: normal; font-variant-emoji: normal; font-stretch: normal; line-height: normal;">&nbsp;&nbsp;</span></span><span lang="EN-US" style="">Childcare
Need and Accessibility</span><span lang="EN-US" style=""><o:p></o:p></span></p><p>

</p><p class="MsoListParagraph" style=""><span lang="EN-US" style="">The
proposed childcare facility, accommodating up to 18 children, would represent
an inappropriate intensification of childcare provision within an established
suburban residential location characterised by relatively poor public transport
accessibility (PTAL 2). The site is not considered suitable to accommodate a
childcare facility of the scale proposed, having regard to the objective of
directing such facilities towards accessible locations within the communities
they are intended to serve. Furthermore, insufficient evidence has been
provided to demonstrate an identified local need for additional childcare
provision in this location which would justify the proposed use. The
development would therefore fail to meet the requirements for appropriately
located childcare facilities serving identified local needs, contrary to Policy
S3 of the London Plan (2021) and Policy SI1 of the Harrow Local Plan
(2021–2041)<font face="Arial, sans-serif"><o:p></o:p></font></span></p>

<p class="MsoListParagraph" style=""><span lang="EN-US" style=""><span style="font-variant-numeric: normal; font-variant-east-asian: normal; font-variant-alternates: normal; font-size-adjust: none; font-language-override: normal; font-kerning: auto; font-optical-sizing: auto; font-feature-settings: normal; font-variation-settings: normal; font-variant-position: normal; font-variant-emoji: normal; font-stretch: normal; line-height: normal;">2.&nbsp; &nbsp;&nbsp;</span></span><!--[endif]--><span lang="EN-US" style="">Impact
on Neighbouring Residential Amenity<o:p></o:p></span></p><p>

</p><p class="MsoListParagraph" style=""><span lang="EN-US" style="">The
proposed childcare use, accommodating up to 18 children within an existing
residential dwellinghouse, would result in an unacceptable intensification of
activity, particularly through regular outdoor play within the rear garden in
close proximity to neighbouring residential properties, notably No. 1 Gyles
Park. The nature, frequency and intensity of the associated noise and general
disturbance would be detrimental to the living conditions and enjoyment of
neighbouring occupiers, which would not be adequately mitigated by the proposed
operational restrictions and management measures. The development would
therefore be contrary to Policy P3 of the NPPF (2026), Policies D13 and D14 of
the London Plan (2021) and Policy GR1 of the Harrow Local Plan (2021–2041).<font face="Arial, sans-serif"><o:p></o:p></font></span></p>
